Kenney Particle Pack
====================

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)
Source:  https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack
Author:  Kenney (kenney.nl)

Selected sprites (resized to 64x64) are bundled in assets/art/particles/
and registered in assets/art/shapes.atlas. Used for projectile heads, hit
flashes and short-lived particles, tinted at runtime.
